name: Recording Piggyback
description: While a channel is recording, in Dispatcharr's DVR or by Sportarr, other channels carrying the same provider stream play through the recording's connection instead of opening another one, and the recorded program gets a red dot in the guide.
author: johnschult

fields.label: Mark recordings in the guide
fields.help_text: Adds a red dot to the end of the title of a program set to record (from when it is scheduled, so apps that reload the guide hourly show it in time), and "🔴 Recording" to its description. Restored when the recording finishes or is cancelled.

fields.label: Never piggyback channels in these groups
fields.help_text: Comma-separated channel group names. Teamarr resets the streams on its own Matchups channels every hour, so adding a piggyback there just gets undone; they're hidden anyway.

fields.label: Use Sportarr's recordings too
fields.help_text: Sportarr records through Dispatcharr like any other viewer, so its recordings never reach Dispatcharr's DVR. Switch this on, and set Sportarr's address and API key under Sportarr below, to give them the same piggybacks and red dots.

fields.label: Sportarr address
fields.help_text: Sportarr's channels must come from Dispatcharr's M3U, so their stream URLs name Dispatcharr channels. Test Sportarr checks it.

actions.label: Sync now
actions.description: Line up piggybacks and guide marks with the recordings running right now. Runs on its own when a recording starts or ends, a channel starts or stops (Sportarr tuning in or hanging up), or the M3U or EPG refreshes.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Show recordings running now and which channels ride them.

actions.label: Test Sportarr
actions.description: Check that Sportarr answers and accepts the key, count its recordings, and name any whose channel can't be matched to a Dispatcharr channel.
